Which of the following statements are true regarding the function $y=\cos x$?

Select all that apply.

- **I.** The graph intersects the $y$-axis at $y=0.$
- **II.** The function has a maximum value at $x=\frac{\pi}{2}.$
- **III.** The function has a minimum value at $x=\pi.$

Let's plot the graph of $y=\cos x$.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/edb-math/repairs/2026-10-27-topic-audit-2/group-1/staged-assets/17592186176047/relocation-a/88378ece5b1721cdc533d07d69c004901539c7f8fda9a5a3e5c5648ed32905c5.png)

- Statement I is false. At $x=0$, the function has value $\cos 0=1$.

- Statement II is false. $\cos\left(\frac{\pi}{2}\right)=0$.

- Statement III is true. $\cos(\pi)=-1$.
